outcome: Relationship between tumor characteristics and ultrasound features, initial mass size
cohort: 228 pregnant patients with persistent adnexal masses at the Beijing Chao-Yang Hospital, Capital Medical University
finding: Mature teratoma was the most common histopathological type of persistent adnexal masses in pregnancy (28.95%), followed by the corpus luteum of pregnancy (16.67%), while borderline/malignant tumors accounted for 5.70% of tumors.
